blocks.text: Let's solve this one step by step. The opposite of the quantity four x minus seven, plus six x minus nine.
The minus in front means negative one times the quantity. It changes both signs: negative four x plus seven.
Now combine. Negative four x plus six x is two x. Seven minus nine is negative two.
So the answer is two x minus two.
Watch out for these traps. If you change only the sign of four x, you get two x minus sixteen. If you ignore the minus in front, you get ten x minus sixteen.
